title: Okta MFA enrollment policy state
description: One Okta MFA_ENROLL (authenticator enrollment) policy. Supersedes okta.mfa_policy.v1, which reported raw group ids as if they were names, never reported WebAuthn from Identity Engine policies, and dropped the policy status.

status.description: Okta's policy status. Okta applies only ACTIVE policies.

priority.description: Okta's evaluation order; 1 is evaluated first. Omitted when Okta reports none.

mfa_required.description: At least one factor other than the password is REQUIRED.

factors_allowed.description: Canonical keys of the factors set to REQUIRED or OPTIONAL, sorted, password excluded. Every FIDO key (Classic fido_webauthn and fido_u2f, Identity Engine webauthn) is reported as webauthn; other keys are Okta's, lower-cased.

applies_to_groups.description: Okta group ids from conditions.people.groups.include, as Okta returned them.

applies_to_everyone.description: applies_to_groups contains the id of the org's Everyone group.
